title: MessageBox
description: Present a confirmation or a short semantic message with predefined localized actions.

usage.summary: Interrupt the current task to report an outcome or obtain a decision.
useWhen: Ask for a short confirmation or show a semantic error with a small action set.
Use useMessageBox for local Promise-based confirmation flows.

avoidWhen.when: Collect input or show a dialog with a custom workflow.
Give inline contextual guidance or brief nonblocking feedback.
